title: Aggregation
text: Besides scans, raw files hold instrument’s status log: readbacks instrument records independently scans (typically every seconds) temperatures, pressures, voltages, ion source settings. orbi_read_raw() returns status_log dataset. channels status log contains depends entirely instrument, none included aggregators take anything .
